design_overview: A modern, professional inventory management system designed for retail environments with emphasis on speed, clarity, and real-time data visibility. The interface prioritizes quick barcode scanning workflows, instant stock level monitoring, and proactive alert management. The design uses a clean card-based layout with strong visual hierarchy, making critical information immediately scannable. Navigation follows native mobile patterns with a bottom tab bar for primary features and contextual top navigation for secondary actions. The color scheme balances professionalism with approachability, using blue as the primary color to convey trust and reliability, while accent colors provide clear status indicators for stock levels and alerts.

User can quickly update stock or view details. Can also manually enter barcode if scanner fails. Returns to previous screen via back button or after completing action.

responsive_design: The design follows a mobile-first approach optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. All components use relative sizing and flexible layouts to adapt to different screen sizes. Cards and lists stack vertically on mobile with full-width layouts minus consistent 16px horizontal margins. Touch targets meet minimum 44x44px accessibility standards. The bottom navigation remains fixed and accessible on all screens. Horizontal scrolling is used sparingly for filter chips and product carousels. The design scales up for tablets by increasing margins and using a two-column layout for cards where appropriate, while maintaining single-column navigation for consistency.
accessibility: All interactive elements meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards with minimum touch target sizes of 44x44px. Color is never the only means of conveying information - stock status uses both color and text labels. Text maintains minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against backgrounds. All icons are accompanied by text labels. Form inputs include clear labels and placeholder text. Error states provide descriptive messages. The app supports dynamic type sizing for users with vision impairments. Screen reader labels are provided for all interactive elements. Focus indicators are visible for keyboard navigation. Alert notifications include both visual and text-based information. Critical actions require confirmation dialogs to prevent accidental data loss.
animations: Animations are subtle and purposeful, enhancing usability without distraction. Screen transitions use 300ms slide animations (right-to-left for forward navigation, left-to-right for back). Modal dialogs slide up from bottom with 250ms duration and ease-out timing. Button presses show immediate visual feedback with 100ms scale-down animation. List items fade in sequentially when loading (50ms stagger). Pull-to-refresh uses standard iOS/Android spinner animation. Floating action buttons have a subtle bounce on appear. Success states show a brief checkmark animation (400ms). Loading states use skeleton screens with shimmer effect rather than spinners. Swipe gestures on alerts and list items reveal action buttons with smooth 200ms transitions. All animations respect system-level reduced motion preferences.
icons: Icons follow a consistent outline style from a cohesive icon family (Lucide or Heroicons). Primary navigation uses: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), filter (funnel), bell (notification), settings (gear). Action icons include: plus (add), edit (pencil), trash (delete), share (share arrow), user (person outline). All icons are 24px by default, scaling to 20px for compact contexts and 32px for prominent actions. Icons maintain 2px stroke width for visual consistency. Color follows the design system: primary blue for active states, medium gray for inactive, white for buttons with colored backgrounds. Icons are never used alone without text labels except in universally recognized contexts like navigation bars.
